Lina (People Ops): Hey team — quick onboarding question. Contractor Diego C starts Monday remote. He needs a temporary Mac loaner, yubikey, and access to staging S3 (read-only). Also wants to delay the phishing sim email for onboarding day. Who should I loop in?

Diego C: Hi everyone! I won’t have hardware on day 1. I’ll be joining training Tues morning. If possible I’d like the phish sim paused until EOD Tue. Also will need VPN access and a bastion ssh key.

Arun (Manager): Ok to pause phish sim until EOD Tue. Confirm non-prod only for buckets. I approve read-only staging access.

Noor (Security): Thanks @Arun. Policy notes: contractors may not have key creation or rotation rights. We can grant temporary decrypt-only on a staging keyring and short-lived IAM creds for S3 read. Phish sim pause: we can add a 72-hour exemption but we need manager signoff (got it). Please file the exemption request form so audit logs capture it.

Sam (IT): We have a loaner available. Workflow: 1) Submit loaner form: https://redwood.internal/it/loaner 2) We ship with MDM pre-enrolled + YubiKey in same package. 3) Diego will receive a tracking email. If pickup preferred, IT desk open 9-4.

Lina (People Ops): Filing the exemption and loaner request now. Diego — do you need the device overnighted or will you be local to SF office?

Diego C: Remote in NY, please ship. ETA for first day matters — I'd prefer arriving before Monday afternoon if possible.

Sam (IT): Shipping label created. Expected delivery Mon AM via express. MDM will push the certs and WiFi profile on first boot. We'll include quickstart and yubikey instructions.

OnboardBot: Reminder: Security 101 course must be completed within 5 business days. Link: https://learn.redwood/sec101 (automated)

Diego C: Thanks. A few technical Qs:
- How do I add the yarn registry cert locally?
- Is there an infra onboarding repo to clone?

Noor (Security): For certs we push the trust bundle to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates and run update-ca-certificates on Linux; Mac will have the profile push. For yarn/reg certs, IT will place dev cert at https://redwood.internal/it/dev-certs.pem and the MDM profile adds it to keychain. Repo: infra/onboarding is internal and we will add you to the team.

Sam (IT): If you need to manually trigger MDM enroll on the loaner run:

```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```
If SSH keys are needed, add your public key to the onboarding ticket or use the bastion-provision flow in the repo.

Lina (People Ops): Action items: loaner shipped, yubikey included, phish sim exemption requested (Arun approved), Noor to create temp decrypt role and S3 read ACL, Sam to push certs and add bastion host.

Noor (Security): I'll open the temp role now: role name staging/decrypt-temp-diego expiring in 3 days. Will also add audit note for the phishing exemption form.

Arun (Manager): Thanks team. Diego — welcome aboard, ping me if anything blocks you Monday. :wave:

Diego C: Appreciate it, everyone. Will watch for the tracking email and onboard checklist. :smile:
